purpose: Fixed developer-authored signed-service diagnostic probes; not a security certificate or held-out adversarial benchmark.

safety_boundaries.network: Socket connect and urllib entry points fail before network I/O.
safety_boundaries.transport: Injected spy raises TransportBlocked before any HTTP request.
safety_boundaries.identity: Real signed service sessions from public demo accounts, fresh service secret per case.
safety_boundaries.storage: Fresh temporary SQLite per case, checked for raw queries, synthetic PII markers and tokens, then deleted.
safety_boundaries.inference: BM25 only, no local encoder or LLM, no model downloads, no paid API.

limitations: Only synthetic fixtures/public demonstration credentials; no production identity, tenant, host compromise, real client data, or paid inference is exercised.
TransportBlocked is an intentional in-memory boundary exception, not an external API request.
Pattern-based DLP and request-scope checks are incomplete; passing these probes is not general security or semantic entailment proof.
Fixed authored probes test specified paths only. They do not establish coverage against unknown attacks, host compromise, concurrent users, or enterprise tenant isolation.
Claim-scope checks use authored tags and known phrasing; passing is not semantic entailment proof or legal completeness.
No external provider response or production identity provider is exercised.
